conditions: Completing Jade Shadows mails the Jade main blueprint and unlocks Ascension on Brutus, Uranus.

groups.meta: 6-8 minutes per run; 11-13 Vestigial Motes normal, 16-18 Steel Path
groups.mode: Steel Path recommended, solo or recruiting chat
conditions: Evensong, Cantare and Harmony share the same reward table, so any single run has about a 14% chance of some Jade part.
Always summon the Sister: collect 3 Sister Beacons during the elevator ride for a Sister of Parvos fight worth more motes and a guaranteed arcane on Steel Path.
Boosters, Nekros' Desecrate and similar loot abilities do not affect part drops or Vestigial Motes; only the Sister's Steel Essence gets boosted.
bonuses: Steel Path packs more motes and Eximus density, doubling as a good Riven Sliver and affinity farm.
Switch to Operator/Drifter and void sling up the elevator shaft to spot the blue/white beacon glow; Titania flying upward also works.

disclosures.title: finding beacons
disclosures.body: Beacons sit on pipes, in side rooms and sometimes the bottom floor; more than 3 spawn, so skip the hard ones. Turning every audio channel down except sound effects makes the beacon chime easy to hear.

disclosures.title: the capsule can't fail
disclosures.body: The capsule is invulnerable while the elevator climbs, so stealth or mobility frames can spend all their time on Boosted Ionic Charges (the bigger, double-outlined ones, which stack up to 50s). If it loses shields during the final escort it just pauses until they regenerate; only deaths fail the mission.

groups.activity: buy whatever parts are still missing
groups.meta: 450 motes covers a full first set; the quest already pays the main blueprint
conditions: The quest grants the main blueprint outright, so only the three components ever cost motes on a first copy.
A second copy needs all 900 motes, since the quest's main-blueprint reward doesn't repeat.
